policy: Reviewer-only expected facts, not UC3 output or an upload input. Accept semantic equivalence, not invented facts. PDF pages are fixed; use section headings for DOCX citations.

annotations.value: No email sending, marketing, profiling or automated decisions
annotations.quote: The application does not send emails, perform marketing, profile employees, or make automated decisions.
annotations.sourceQuote: The application does not send emails, perform marketing, profile employees, or make automated decisions.

annotations.value: Collect five client fields and generate id
annotations.quote: Collection: POST /api/enrolments accepts employeeId, employeeName, workEmail, courseCode and completionStatus from a local HTTP client. The application generates id; clients cannot submit additional fields.
annotations.sourceQuote: Collection: POST /api/enrolments accepts employeeId, employeeName, workEmail, courseCode and completionStatus from a local HTTP client. The application generates id; clients cannot submit additional fields.

annotations.value: Validate, store in memory and return enrolments
annotations.quote: Use: the Node.js service validates input, adds the enrolment to its in-memory array and returns the created record. GET /api/enrolments returns records to any local client without authentication.
annotations.sourceQuote: Use: the Node.js service validates input, adds the enrolment to its in-memory array and returns the created record. GET /api/enrolments returns records to any local client without authentication.

annotations.value: Local API access and repository publication of synthetic data

annotations.sourceQuote: Publishing the repository exposes its synthetic seed data and documents according to GitHub repository visibility.

annotations.value: Local tester intended; any local client can access records

annotations.sourceQuote: Sharing: the local tester is the only intended API recipient, but access is not enforced by identity.

annotations.value: Local seed JSON persists until manually removed

annotations.sourceQuote: Two synthetic seed enrolments persist in fixtures/application.json on the local machine.

annotations.value: Runtime data in local process memory, lost on restart
annotations.quote: Runtime enrolments are stored only in Node.js process memory on that machine and are lost on restart; the seed file remains unchanged until manually removed.
annotations.sourceQuote: Runtime enrolments are stored only in Node.js process memory on that machine and are lost on restart; the seed file remains unchanged until manually removed.

annotations.value: Publicly available privacy statement linked from the homepage before data submission, readable without authentication
annotations.quote: Control TC-PD-03: A privacy statement shall be publicly available and easily accessible to users. The Training Register Demo homepage shall provide a clearly identifiable privacy statement link before users submit employee enrolment data. Users shall be able to open and read the statement without authentication or other access restrictions.
annotations.sourceQuote: Control TC-PD-03: A privacy statement shall be publicly available and easily accessible to users. The Training Register Demo homepage shall provide a clearly identifiable privacy statement link before users submit employee enrolment data. Users shall be able to open and read the statement without authentication or other access restrictions.

annotations.value: User consent required before enrolment submission and storage; block storage without consent
annotations.quote: Control TC-PD-02: Personal data shall be collected only with user consent. For this synthetic assessment scenario, user consent is required before employee enrolment information is submitted and stored. The registration frontend shall collect an affirmative consent choice before submission, and the application shall block storage when that consent is absent.
annotations.sourceQuote: Control TC-PD-02: Personal data shall be collected only with user consent. For this synthetic assessment scenario, user consent is required before employee enrolment information is submitted and stored. The registration frontend shall collect an affirmative consent choice before submission, and the application shall block storage when that consent is absent.

annotations.value: Managed encryption-key storage restricted to separate administrator and application roles
annotations.quote: Control TC-DS-03: The proposed enrolment encryption key shall be stored in a managed key service with access restricted to distinct key-administrator and application roles.
annotations.section: S9 - Encryption-key storage and rotation requirement
annotations.sourceQuote: Control TC-DS-03: The proposed enrolment encryption key shall be stored in a managed key service with access restricted to distinct key-administrator and application roles.

annotations.value: Automatic key rotation at least every 90 days
annotations.quote: Automatic key rotation shall be configured at least every 90 days.
annotations.section: S9 - Encryption-key storage and rotation requirement
annotations.sourceQuote: Automatic key rotation shall be configured at least every 90 days.

annotations.value: Internal application enrolment reads and writes require Microsoft Entra authentication with MFA
annotations.quote: Access to GET and POST /api/enrolments shall require authentication through Microsoft Entra with MFA before records can be read or created.
annotations.sourceQuote: Access to GET and POST /api/enrolments shall require authentication through Microsoft Entra with MFA before records can be read or created.

annotations.value: Enrolment read/create audit events with authenticated user identity, UTC timestamp, action, record reference and outcome
annotations.quote: Control TC-DS-06: Reads through GET /api/enrolments and creation through POST /api/enrolments shall produce audit events containing authenticated user identity, UTC timestamp, action, record reference and outcome.
annotations.sourceQuote: Control TC-DS-06: Reads through GET /api/enrolments and creation through POST /api/enrolments shall produce audit events containing authenticated user identity, UTC timestamp, action, record reference and outcome.
